task_instance: Goal-led exploration of `gh issue create` invoked without arguments: choose one behavior/outcome case ("gh issue create without arguments prompts"), execute it against the real `gh` CLI, and produce the skill's required deliverable (a faithful chaptered terminal-session recording plus evidence/verdict), as directed by cli-exercise-explore in concert with its sibling cli-exercise-run and cli-exercise-evidence modules.
blocker_detail: cli-exercise-explore is only the decision-logic module of the parent 'cli-exercise' skill; its actual deliverable (execution + a faithful terminal recording) is produced by a Go helper (built from source not present anywhere in the skill package -- only SKILL.md and LICENSE exist under cli__cli__cli-exercise) that wraps Node's Tuistory PTY-testing library and shells out to ffmpeg/ffprobe to render the chaptered session video. In this runtime: (1) the Go helper's source code does not exist to build -- the skill package ships no Go module, only documentation referencing one; (2) ffmpeg/ffprobe are not installed and `apt-get install ffmpeg` fails because the apt package sources for this image's pinned library versions are unavailable (dependency version resolution errors for libva, libvpx, libsdl2, etc.); (3) the skill's stated compatibility requirement of Go 1.27+ is unmet (installed Go is 1.24.7); (4) Tuistory is a real npm package but has never been vetted/integrated here and, without ffmpeg, cannot produce the mandated MP4/GIF evidence artifact anyway. Because the explore flow's contract requires 'Actually execute and record' each case and finish with a rendered evidence video (not merely run a command), and the rendering toolchain is neither present nor installable in this sandboxed image, the core deliverable cannot be produced or verified here.
evidence: Read /home/user/skill-achievability-compiler/benchmark/ce_sources/cli__cli__cli-exercise-explore/SKILL.md and its sibling modules (cli-exercise, cli-exercise-run, cli-exercise-evidence, cli-exercise-preflight) to determine the real deliverable is a recorded, rendered terminal session, not just command output. `find .../cli__cli__cli-exercise -type f` showed only SKILL.md and LICENSE -- no Go source, no references/, no internal/ modules actually shipped, confirming the helper binary this flow depends on does not exist to build. `which ffmpeg` / `which ffprobe` returned nothing (not found); `go version` reported go1.24.7, below the skill's stated 'Requires Go 1.27+'. `apt-get install -y ffmpeg` (run as root) failed with repeated 'Can't find a source to download version ...' errors for numerous transitive libraries, showing ffmpeg cannot be installed in this image either. `npm view tuistory` confirmed the Tuistory package exists on npm (0.11.0) but it alone cannot satisfy the recording requirement without ffmpeg and the missing Go helper. gh CLI itself (/usr/bin/gh) is present and could run the underlying `gh issue create` command directly, but that only exercises the command -- it does not produce the skill's mandated chaptered evidence recording, so the exploration flow's actual contract (goal -> chosen cases -> executed + recorded + rendered evidence) could not be completed or verified.
